description: Types shared by several contract files: the side-effect classes, token usage and artifact descriptors.

EffectClass.description: How a tool call changes the world. It decides the retry semantics of a segment (external_write and privileged run at most once), the default approval policy and the forced segment boundary.

Usage.description: Token counts and estimated integer millicredits for one model over one segment. Exact usage is reported through UsageReport with per-request idempotency keys; the control ledger is authoritative.

model.description: Name of the model that served the calls, as resolved from the tenant model profile.

input_tokens.description: Prompt tokens billed at the normal input rate.

cache_read_tokens.description: Prompt tokens served from the provider prompt cache.

cache_write_tokens.description: Prompt tokens written to the provider prompt cache.

cost_millicredits.description: Integer millicredits (1000 = 1 credit). Platform credits these tokens cost.

Artifact.description: A file produced by a run in the sandbox output directory, content-addressed and stored in the object store.

path.description: Path relative to the run output directory, normalized, with forward slashes.

digest.description: sha256 of the content, as sha256:<hex>.

size_bytes.description: Size of the content in bytes.

object_ref.description: Object store key of the content, relative to the tenant prefix.
